senses.definition: n.pr.loc. (God openeth; cf. Sab.n.pr.m. יפתחאל Hal 148:1);—in גֵּי יִפ׳ (Γαιφαηλ, Γαι και Φθαιηλ, A 𝔊L Γαι (Ι)εφθαηλ), valley betw. Zebulun and Asher Jos 19:14, 27 (P); prob. near Jêfât (Jotapata), and perhaps upper part of Wady ʿAbellîn, v. BuhlGeogr. 109, 223.
